title: Mallworld dream meet up update
content: I was excited to see the response to my previous post about trying to meet in mallworld. We had some good suggestions that I think could help this meetup happen. The meetup location that most people seem to be able to access is the Auditorium. I myself have been having a lot of dreams taking place there these past few weeks. Also let’s have a keyword in mind, someone suggested octopus. This is my first time trying this so having a keyword might be a good way to identify each other. Date? I’m not sure yet, please let me know what you think. I don’t think it should be tonight but a couple of days out so we can plan and prep. Let’s make this happen!
